data.description: The root: { id, label, value?, children? }. A branch's value is the sum of its children.

label.description: Names the chart for assistive technology.

formatValue.description: Formats the centre value, legend, tooltip, and table.

depth.description: Rings shown around the centre at once. Fewer levels below a zoomed node fill the full radius.

size.description: Largest diameter in pixels. The chart scales down to fit its container.

focus.description: Controlled id of the node in the centre.

defaultFocus.description: Initial centre when uncontrolled. Defaults to the root.

onFocusChange.description: Called when a segment, breadcrumb, legend row, or the centre zooms.

legend.description: Lists the children of the centre with values and shares, synced with the arcs.

emptyLabel.description: Shown in the centre when the total is zero.
